question: In a certain code language, 'RHETORIC' is coded as '6' and 'GURGLE' is coded as '4'. What will be the code for 'SIGNATURE' in the given code language?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6e81f3ed21fddc72dd7e74439132a9341e1cd67dad9da66ee032ef789862eab.png] The logic followed here is: Logic: Number of letters in the word - 2 = Code of the word. 'RHETORIC' is coded as '6' No. of letters in the word 'RHETORIC' is 8.
